snippet.title: Tidyspell — Official Gameplay Trailer | Cozy Magical Cleaning Game
snippet.description:
Tidyspell is a cozy first person magical cleaning game where you use telekinesis and spells to tidy up a whimsical home, catch little spirits, grow your magical abilities, and discover mysterious portals and hidden spaces.

Wishlist Tidyspell on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5286160/Tidyspell/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=steam_page_announcement&utm_content=official_gameplay_trailer
